recommended_overlay_yaml.description: Per-run isolation overlay; pass `--config <file>` (repeatable). Verified E_iso, R_repo_iso. Use together with --no-extensions.
recommended_overlay_yaml.yaml:
disabledProviders: [native, omp-managed, skillshare, agents-md, agents, claude-md, claude-plugins, claude, cline, codex, cursor, gemini, github, mcp-json, omp-plugins, opencode, ssh-json, vscode, windsurf, agent-plugins, builtin-defaults]
skills:
  enableClaudeProject: false
  enablePiUser: false
  enablePiProject: false
  enableAgentsUser: false
  enableAgentsProject: false
  enableCodexUser: false
  enableClaudeUser: false
  customDirectories:
    - <repo>/omp_bridge/skills
mcp:
  enableProjectConfig: false
memory:
  backend: "off"
advisor:
  enabled: false
ttsr:
  builtinRules: false
recommended_overlay_yaml.caveat: `disabledProviders` is a shared setting: the same key also blocks MODEL provider ids; none of the ids above collides with a model provider id (cursor/github-copilot differ) but re-check if the user uses a model provider literally named cursor/github/codex/gemini/opencode. Overlay REPLACES the user's disabledProviders (currently []).

open_risks: task subagents from project .omp/agents (and ~/.omp/agent/agents) are not blockable by disabledProviders; need task.disabledAgents by name or drop the task tool. Bundled agents (scout, reviewer, security-reviewer, task, sonic) always present.
disabledProviders overlay replaces the user's array; and shares a key with model-provider disabling (ids do not collide today).

OMP overlay/env semantics were verified only for rpc mode --no-session in 18.4.4; a minor upgrade can change provider ids or defaults (e.g. skills.enableAgentsUser default true). Workbench should assert via get_state.systemPrompt/get_available_commands at startup (zero-cost introspection) and fail if unexpected skill/context names appear.

Depth-dedupe of context files means Workbench cannot rely on repo AGENTS.md reaching the worker in base OMP; with isolation it gets none, so any needed instructions must be passed explicitly (--append-system-prompt / -e extension).
User-level mcp.json, hooks dirs, custom tools dir, managed/skillshare skills and hindsight/mnemopi injection are code-verified only (no such files/config on this machine).
Extensions (-e) explicitly passed are still loaded with --no-extensions; extension code itself can register tools/commands.
MCP servers configured in ~/.omp/agent/mcp.json / plugins would need disabledProviders native + omp-plugins (done in overlay).
--profile / PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR must not be used (drops auth).
